highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews Skia m154 and ships XML API documentation with its NuGet packages.
highlights_body: The release aligns the bundled renderer with Chrome milestone 154, updates HarfBuzzSharp generation to its bundled native source, and makes package documentation available to consumers.

breaking.title: HarfBuzzSharp corrects the CCC132 enum name
breaking.body: `UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133` has been renamed to `CCC132` to match upstream HarfBuzz while retaining numeric value 132. Update source references to the corrected member name.

breaking.title: HarfBuzzSharp no longer exposes aggregate Defined flags
breaking.body: `GlyphFlags.Defined` is removed, and aggregate `Defined` members are not exposed for buffer flags. Combine the concrete flags your application needs when constructing a mask.

bullets.detail: Aligns the bundled renderer with Chrome milestone 154 and incorporates its upstream bug fixes.

bullets.lead: HarfBuzzSharp generation follows the bundled native source
bullets.detail: Bindings are generated from the HarfBuzz revision pinned by Skia, keeping ordinary managed declarations synchronized with the native library while excluding unsupported callback-heavy APIs.

bullets.lead: XML API documentation ships with packages
bullets.detail: NuGet packages now include compiler-generated XML documentation, making API comments available to IDE tooling alongside the managed assemblies.

contributor_summaries.azchohfi: Improved the HarfBuzzSharp native build configuration by scoping compiler warning suppressions

preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9: Preview 1 opened the 4.154 line with the Skia m154 engine update.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 generates its bindings from the same DEPS-pinned source as the bundled native library, synchronizing supported declarations with that release.

v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 Preview 1 begins the 4.154 line on Skia m154.
v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.body: It brings the latest upstream renderer into the preview line without changing the managed API surface.
